create.name: Rose Cole
create.bio:
Rose Cole is a shamanic teacher and ceremonialist who has worked with students and private clients for more than two decades. She grew up in a household later shaped by her adoptive father, an Apache man known by the medicine name Bitter Root, and she traces the start of her own path to watching him return to his people's ceremonial ways. From that early grounding she developed what she calls Universal Shamanism, a non-denominational approach that she is careful to distinguish from claiming any indigenous lineage as her own.

She founded the Sacred Oak Academy, an online certification school, and teaches through two systems of her own, Guided Energy Medicine and the Liminal Alchemy Method. Her six-month Liminal Alchemy training is aimed at practitioners who already hold space for others, and she also offers long private sessions over Zoom and small ceremonial weekends on the land. Her free material includes recorded prayer circles and drum journeys on her YouTube channel. She is an ordained minister and leads BeautyWay In Unity, a non-profit that gives part of the Academy's income to projects protecting sacred lands and traditional communities. She has also co-written a book with Deepak Chopra and appears on spiritual podcasts and online summits.

courses.title: Liminal Alchemy
courses.description: A six-month online apprenticeship in Rose Cole's Guided Energy Medicine path for people who already work as practitioners or space holders. It runs on twice-monthly live sessions with her, small practice groups and inquiry circles, with an optional certification at the end.

courses.title: Sacred Alchemy Session
courses.description: A 75-minute private session with Rose over Zoom, built around her Liminal Alchemy Method. It combines energetic clearing with spiritual guidance for people at a turning point or making sense of unusual spiritual experiences, and comes with a recording.

free_resources.title: Free Gift: Which of the 9 Shamanic Gifts You Possess
free_resources.description: A free guide from Rose Cole that helps readers work out which of her nine shamanic gifts they lean towards. It includes an activation prayer and suggestions for putting those gifts to use.
